title: Co-Pilot approval reachable on a short window
description: Use private GATEWAY_PORT/VITE_PORT, an owned headless Agent Chrome FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT and FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EVIDENCE. Uses the real mounted Co-Pilot panel and native session view with a controlled fixture: a running Co-Pilot runtime and one pending approval. No native host, provider, device or gateway activation. To reproduce the original UI, select its FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_UI_ROOT and FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EXPECT_SHIFT=1.
